card.name: Day numbers and weekdays before months
card.fires_on: Weekday names or the first digit of a day-of-month number in dates, right before a month name. Also the number 1 in book names like 1 Samuel.

modes.label: Weekday before date
modes.description: A weekday abbreviation in a post or file timestamp, followed by a month name.

modes.label: Day number before month
modes.description: A digit of the day in a date, with the month name coming next.
modes.example: approved by the King in an Order in Council of <<5>> November 1800.

modes.label: Numbered book
modes.description: The number 1 before a biblical book name such as Samuel.
modes.example: The record of his life is found in <<1>> Samuel 16-31;

card.writes: It favors tokens like $ and single letters, and suppresses month-abbreviation continuations like -May and -Jun, so it mainly stops a hyphenated month from following.
card.plain: It lights up on day numbers and weekday names just before a month in a date.
